ready1_open_rewrite.raw_question_text: As shown in the figure, $A$, $B$, $C$ are the vertices of small squares, and the side length of each small square is $1$. What is the value of $\sin\angle ABC$?
ready1_open_rewrite.raw_answer_text:
\textbf{Solution:} Connect AC, \\
AC $= \sqrt{5}$, BC $= \sqrt{5}$, AB $= \sqrt{10}$, \\
$\therefore \triangle ABC$ is a right-angled triangle, \\
$\therefore \sin\angle ABC = \frac{AC}{AB} = \frac{\sqrt{5}}{\sqrt{10}} = \boxed{\frac{\sqrt{2}}{2}}$;
